sources.ref: Owner direction 2026-10-16: BONUS_PAYMENT_ENABLED=0 pilot — $3.00 flat, no bonus offered or paid
S5 approved protocol: $4 online base, no bonus selected

notes: v1 (2026-10-16, owner direction): the no-bonus payment posture for the BONUS_PAYMENT_ENABLED=0 pilot. base_cents 300 — the same $3.00 online base as payment.s5_base_only@v4 — with no $0.50 accuracy bonus: consent.reference.nobonus@v1 never offers it and no copy mentions it, so nothing is owed beyond the base. Rules otherwise identical to payment.s5_base_only@v5 (activatable, technical_stop base_paid, bonus none, withdrawal forfeits base).

Selected by the deployment flag, not by manifest pin — manifests still bind payment.s5_base_only@v5 as their bonus-on contract. When BONUS_PAYMENT_ENABLED=0 the entitlement row records this artifact id+version so the ledger shows which policy actually computed the session's payment.
300 cents for ~12 minutes stays above the university IRB $10/hour minimum.
